meta.name: The Rifleman
meta.description:
One of the greatest Westerns of all time is now playing on its own 24/7 channel, only on Pluto TV. Chuck Connors stars as Lucas McCain: Union Army vet, rancher, father, and owner of the fastest .44 Winchester in the West.

24/7: The Rifleman
Available on: Pluto TV, Tubi, Plex
